set_prop_checked() {
    local key="$1"
    local expected="$2"
    local reset_arg="$3"
    local actual=""
    local i=0
    if [ -x "$R" ]; then
        if [ "$reset_arg" = "-n" ]; then
            "$R" -n "$key" "$expected" 2>/dev/null
        else
            "$R" "$key" "$expected" 2>/dev/null
        fi
    else
        setprop "$key" "$expected" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    while [ "$i" -lt 10 ]; do
        actual="$(getprop "$key" 2>/dev/null)"
        [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] && return 0
        i=$((i + 1))
        sleep 0.05
    done
    [ -z "$actual" ] && actual="<empty>"
    echo "[PROP_CHECK] failed: $key expected=$expected actual=$actual" >&2
    PROP_FAILED=1
    return 0
}
